sections.heading: Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences Reviews

content.text: Rajarajeshwari College of Allied Health Sciences features reviews from alumni and current students who have built successful careers in major hospitals and healthcare organizations. These reviews help prospective students understand the academic atmosphere, practical experience, and facilities at Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences, allowing them to make informed choices.

Faculty The faculty at Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences are well-qualified and highly experienced in fields like Cardiac Care, Operation Theatre Technology, and Medical Imaging. They are recognized for being approachable and friendly. The teaching methods include interactive learning, regular assessments, and hands-on training, ensuring students develop both academic knowledge and clinical skills.

Clinical Exposure and Placement Clinical training starts early, usually in the second year, with students assigned to the associated Rajarajeshwari Hospital, a multi-specialty facility. This exposure allows students to experience real healthcare practices. The allied health sciences department offers active placement support through partnerships with hospitals such as Apollo, Aster, and Narayana Health. Courses like Perfusion Technology and Respiratory Therapy have placement records with packages reaching ₹10 to ₹11 LPA, especially for roles in the Middle East and other countries. Students also gain from internship opportunities during their studies.

Infrastructure Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences provides modern facilities dedicated to allied health courses. Amenities include fully equipped skill labs, simulation-based learning spaces, subject-specific labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. Separate hostel accommodations are available for boys and girls, offering amenities like Wi-Fi, good food, and 24/7 security.

Campus Life Campus life is vibrant and student-oriented. The college organizes regular academic workshops, skill development programs, seminars, and inter-college events to keep students informed about the latest in healthcare. Cultural events, sports, and talent competitions encourage students to pursue interests outside their studies, fostering a well-rounded lifestyle and personal growth.

Affordability The fee structure at Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences is competitive compared to other private institutions that offer similar programs. The college also provides scholarship options and installment payment plans. Financial aid is available for eligible students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds.

The fees for Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences is affordable, that makes the students to choose this institution over others. Moreover, the college supports the students with scholarship programs which makes this course can be accessible to all.
